note: Hand-authored ground truth for the real external docs, written BEFORE any docling run on them (T5 criteria: transcription recorded before extraction). Superscript/subscript typography is flattened the way the PDF text layer flattens it (e.g. 10^20 -> 1020); the grader normalizes by casefolding and stripping ALL whitespace, and maps unicode superscripts to digits, so '1.0·1020' matches '1.0 · 10^20' and '1.0·10²⁰'.
